title: Settings
purpose: Change how a workspace or account behaves, deciding per section whether changes apply now or save together.
useWhen: A page of settings mixes standalone preferences, records saved together and destructive actions.
avoidWhen: A single record form with no standalone preferences; use the edit-record contract alone.
alternatives: Use the edit-record contract for one record's form, and the consequential-action contract for a single destructive action outside settings.
requiredInputs: current settings and who may change each section
a save adapter per record saved together
a write adapter per apply-now preference
consequence and execute adapter per destructive action
transitions: ready → apply-pending when an apply-now control changes
apply-pending → apply-committed on acknowledgement, or apply-failed with the control restored
ready → draft-dirty when a field saved together changes
draft-dirty → draft-submitting on save, or ready on discard
draft-submitting → ready on success, or draft-failed with the draft kept
applicability: Settings pages that combine standalone preferences, records saved together and destructive actions.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; a page with only one mode needs only that mode's states.
